title: Predator turnover turns the digestion-driven ecology into lagged predator-prey swings and real selection: when each predator kind is made from the prey it digests and decays while dissolved, the non-hunting kind is excluded without mutation (e/b 1 -> 100 by t=12000), held at e/b 1.6-5.2 by bath mutation, and two equal kinds stay at 0.9-1.3 while prey and predators swing together (prey 43 -> 2-5 -> 29 -> 3-7) on two seeds
summary: world2g.py is world2m.py (20261027T0510-c52-bath-mutation-selection: two conserved digestion-driven predator kinds b and e, kind-blind interconversion only in solution) plus turnover: a fraction yg of the prey material each kind digests becomes that kind's material instead of waste, and dissolved predator material decays to waste at kdec (gated off in bodies); the ledger prey + predators + waste stays closed. mdrive.py, 128^2, t=12000, kinds added at t=2000. yg 0.1 / kdec 2e-3 and yg 0.5 / kdec 2e-4 (and the matching neutral run) lose every predator body by t~6000-8000 (sel_s0.json, neu_s0.json); yg 1.0 / kdec 5e-4 crashes the prey to 0 for ~4000 t. At yg 0.5 / kdec 5e-4 (gro/A_*.json, turnover.png): neutral (both kinds hunt), seeds 0 and 1: prey 43 -> 2-5 (t~6000) -> 29 (t~9000-10000) -> 3-7, predator kinds following together with a lag (27 -> 1-7 -> 25-33 -> 6-15 bodies), e/b 0.92-1.26 throughout; selective (e hunts, b has no taxis): b never holds more than 1 body, e/b rises to 5.2/4.8 by t=3000, falls to 1.7/1.6 when the prey crash and the e bodies dissolve, and rises again to 4.1/5.2; same without mutation: e/b 3.0 -> 9.1 -> 38.5 -> 100 (b decays away, e keeps 14-41 bodies).

finding.operator: predator turnover (material made from digested prey, decay while dissolved) on two digestion-driven predator kinds with kind-blind bath interconversion
finding.control: neutral twin with equal kinds (same seeds); selective arm without interconversion
finding.result: e/b at t=12000: selective 2.79/2.89 (peaks 5.2/5.2), neutral 1.10/1.08, no mutation 100; prey swing 43 -> 2-5 -> 29 -> 3-7 in the neutral arms

limits: Only one and a half swings in 10000 t on two seeds at 128^2: not enough to call them limit cycles (the rubric asks for peak spacing on 3 seeds and a grid check). The two kinds are fixed (no new variants), and the hunting trait is c46's written taxis. Turnover makes the predators partly built from prey (yg 0.5 of what they digest), so their E is now partly by construction; their condensation still needs their own digestion product. One parameter point survives of four tried; drive-style counts, no labkit packs, no division counts.
